d:
Manithan Tamil Movie Songs, Kaala Kaala Video Song, featuring Rajinikanth and Rupini in lead roles.
The movie was dubbed in Hindi as Bihari Gunda.
The movie is about a man Raja (Rajinikanth), who returns from jail due to an innocent crime committed during his young age. He continues to do good deeds to the poor and needy, and faces problems from his enemies. The rest of the story is about how Raja succeeds over his enemies.
Release Date : 21 October 1987
Star Cast : Rajinikanth, Rupini, Raghuvaran, Srividya, Senthil, Jai Ganesh, Madhuri, Delhi Ganesh
Director : SP Muthuraman
